- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — model tends to overshoot, especially after spikes.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (negative sentiment < -0.10) — model is overly conservative, often missing upward reversals.
- Lag in price recovery: model delays peak recognition by 1–2 days after sentiment shifts from negative to positive.
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects after sharp spikes, leading to premature troughs.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts consistently underestimate upward momentum in high-sentiment periods, especially when sentiment is trending upward.
- Avoid extrapolating recent volatility into future direction — sentiment volatility should be smoothed before forecasting.
